author.name: Automation Alex
author.role: Builds automated ML pipelines to ensure seamless integration and deployment. Prioritizes reliable infrastructure for frequent software deployments. Maintains system operational stability and focuses on CI/CD tooling.

challenge.name: The Locked Shadow
challenge.description: A supplier contract for the next promotion week is already signed, and the team cannot deploy the new model without a shadow run to verify it. #reliability_ruth# demands a fully automated and governed shadow environment to protect the live forecast, while #automation_alex# insists on keeping it manual to avoid breaking the current pipeline stability.

output.content: I am prepared to adjust the canary trigger to fire on every new version so we can validate the shadow run without manual intervention. In exchange, the rest of the pipeline must remain exactly as it is today. I will not touch the existing automation steps or add new tooling to the main deployment path. If we keep the core infrastructure stable and do not expand the automated scope beyond that single trigger, I can support the verification process. This is the only concession I will make to protect the current operational stability while we test the new model.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly offers to adjust the canary trigger (a concession) in exchange for the guarantee that the rest of the pipeline remains unchanged, stating they will accept losing the benefit of broader automation to protect operational stability.
